title: P0-B ADVISE influence bridge (retrieved lessons change real ACTs)

judgments.rationale: Closes Superbrain Report bottleneck #1: retrieved lessons now provably change authorized action plans before ACT executes. kernel_behavior_engine.py is the live engine — this runs in production behavior.
Bottleneck #1 closed: from 'retrieved learning does not reliably influence action' to proven influence. The biggest behavioral delta in tonight's sample.
318 lines of new tests prove the bridge; merged 21:17:33Z. The 'before' (bottleneck open) is attested via the Superbrain Report, not captured in-repo.
Tests guard the bridge — but the change left test_measure_node_influence failing (invocation count 9->10), parked for a builder seat. A bridge with a known crack underneath.
